traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and verified by passing tests. The plugin supports the `@supports story-path REQ-ID...` format, validates each requirement against its referenced story file (with path and requirement scoping), treats @supports as satisfying both story and requirement presence checks while preserving legacy @story/@req behavior, supports mixed usage in the same file/comment, and surfaces clear error messages that include the story path. Comprehensive unit tests for valid/invalid/mixed scenarios all pass, and user-facing documentation (API reference and Migration Guide) explains the @supports format and migration strategy. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes.
